chunks: Narró por nosotros Abu Nasr Ahmad ibn Al-Husayn al-Dhabbi, y no había conocido a nadie más parcialista (nasabi) que él, y se narró respecto a su parcialista que solía decir:

Oh God, send blessings upon Muhammad alone, and he refrained from sending blessings upon his family. He said: I heard Abu Bakr al-Hammamy al-Farra', one of the tradition narrators, in a place called Sikkat Harb in Nishapur, saying: 'Some people entrusted me with a deposit, so I buried it and forgot its location. When a period of time had passed, the owner of the deposit came to me demanding it, but I did not know its location and was confused. The owner accused me, so I left my house grieving and confused. I saw a group of people heading to the Shrine of Ar-Rida (peace be upon him), so I went with them to the Shrine, visited, and prayed to God to make clear to me the location of the deposit. I saw there, in what the sleeper sees, as if a man came to me and said to me: "You buried the deposit in such and such a place." So I returned to the owner of the deposit and directed him to that place which I had seen in the dream, while I myself did not believe in what I had seen. The owner of the deposit went to that place, dug it up, and extracted the deposit with the seal of its owner intact. After that, the man used to narrate this story to the people and urge them to visit this Shrine, greetings and peace be upon its resident.'

key_terms.فَرْدًا: Solo (refiriéndose a Muhammad solo, excluyendo a la familia)
key_terms.نَصْب: Sesgo (específicamente contra los Ahl al-Bayt, a menudo usado para Nasibi)

ai.seo_question: ¿Cuál es la historia del depósito perdido y el Santuario del Imam al-Rida en la tradición chií?
ai.summary: Esta narración de Shaykh al-Saduq en *'Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* ilustra el concepto de *karamat* (milagros de los Imames) a través de un hombre que, tras perder un depósito enterrado, recibió un sueño que revelaba su ubicación tras visitar el Santuario del Imam al-Rida en Tus. Subraya la creencia chií en el poder intercesor de los Ahl al-Bayt y la eficacia espiritual de la *ziyarat* (visita) para resolver las ansiedades mundanas y obtener claridad divina.
